flow case.lifecycle v1
title: Case lifecycle
start: zone_check
stage previsit: Before the visit
stage visit: Visit
stage postvisit: After the visit
stage collection: Collection
step zone_check [Decision] Check the zone of the case
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Judges with the rule `lifecycle.zone_ready` using `practice_zone`. The result field `ready` says where the flow goes.
  on:yes: If `ready` is yes: go to Pre-visit stage
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Operations: zone missing
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Operations: zone missing
step previsit [Child process] Pre-visit stage
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Starts the process `previsit.outreach` and waits until it ends. It sends `case_ref` and `practice_zone`. It keeps `missing_at_close`.
  on:previsit_closed: If the process ends with previsit closed: go to Visit stage
  on:previsit_unreachable: If the process ends with previsit unreachable: go to Visit stage
  onError: If the process fails: go to Operations: pre-visit problem
step visit [Child process] Visit stage
  stage: Visit
  does: Starts the process `visit.note_wait` and waits until it ends. It sends `case_ref`.
  on:note_signed: If the process ends with note signed: go to Post-visit stage
  on:visit_cancelled: If the process ends with visit cancelled: go to Closed, no visit
  onError: If the process fails: go to Operations: visit problem
step postvisit [Child process] Post-visit stage
  stage: After the visit
  does: Starts the process `postvisit.coding_review` and waits until it ends. It sends `assist_enabled` and `case_ref`.
  on:coding_approved: If the process ends with coding approved: go to Collection stage
  on:coding_rejected: If the process ends with coding rejected: go to Closed, not billed
  onError: If the process fails: go to Operations: post-visit problem
step collection [Child process] Collection stage
  stage: Collection
  does: Starts the process `collection.followup` and waits until it ends. It sends `case_ref`.
  on:collected: If the process ends with collected: go to Collected
  on:manual_close: If the process ends with manual close: go to Closed by a person
  on:written_off: If the process ends with written off: go to Written off
  onError: If the process fails: go to Operations: collection problem
step ops_zone [Task for a person] Operations: zone missing
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Operations. A person chooses Continue or Close the case. The person sees `case_ref`.
  on:close: If the person chooses Close the case: go to Closed by a person
  on:continue: If the person chooses Continue: go to Visit stage
step ops_previsit [Task for a person] Operations: pre-visit problem
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Operations. A person chooses Continue or Close the case. The person sees `case_ref`.
  on:close: If the person chooses Close the case: go to Closed by a person
  on:continue: If the person chooses Continue: go to Visit stage
step ops_visit [Task for a person] Operations: visit problem
  stage: Visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Operations. A person chooses Close the case. The person sees `case_ref` and `missing_at_close`.
  on:close: If the person chooses Close the case: go to Closed by a person
step ops_postvisit [Task for a person] Operations: post-visit problem
  stage: After the visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Operations. A person chooses Close the case. The person sees `case_ref`.
  on:close: If the person chooses Close the case: go to Closed by a person
step ops_collection [Task for a person] Operations: collection problem
  stage: Collection
  does: Gives a task to the queue Operations. A person chooses Close the case. The person sees `case_ref`.
  on:close: If the person chooses Close the case: go to Closed by a person
step collected [End] Collected
  stage: Collection
  does: Ends the case with the result Collected.
step written_off [End] Written off
  stage: Collection
  does: Ends the case with the result Written off.
step closed_no_visit [End] Closed, no visit
  stage: Visit
  does: Ends the case with the result Closed, no visit.
step closed_not_billed [End] Closed, not billed
  stage: After the visit
  does: Ends the case with the result Closed, not billed.
step manual_close [End] Closed by a person
  stage: Collection
  does: Ends the case with the result Closed by a person.
